steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。新容量 832 Mbit，亦即 104 MB；次要檔最多 24 MB。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. New capacity is 832 Mbit or 104 MB; at most 24 MB remains for secondary data.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 共同時窗 600 s，不是兩站可見時間的加總。
steps.checkEn: Common visibility is 600 s, not the sum of station windows.

steps.instruction:
鏈路強度正常而資料尾段缺失，先比對共同可見截止時間與緩衝區，不直接歸咎天線增益。
對照「雙站窗口交集」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。排程量必須低於有效容量並保留捕獲裕度；無法完成的檔案需切段或延後。
本階段必須重驗：共同時窗 600 s，不是兩站可見時間的加總。
steps.instructionEn:
Normal signal strength with missing tail data calls for checking common-visibility cutoff and buffers before antenna gain.
Against the nominal Two-station overlap result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Scheduled volume must fit useful capacity with acquisition margin; split or defer files that cannot finish.
Reverify this criterion: Common visibility is 600 s, not the sum of station windows.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。鏈路強度正常而資料尾段缺失，先比對共同可見截止時間與緩衝區，不直接歸咎天線增益。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Normal signal strength with missing tail data calls for checking common-visibility cutoff and buffers before antenna gain.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

steps.title: 雙站窗口交集 · 驗收並留下交接件

steps.objective: 完成「雙站窗口交集」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Two-station overlap and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付雙站時間軸、容量帳及未完成區段表，標清資料是否完整。
在交接件中加入「雙站窗口交集」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：共同時窗 600 s，不是兩站可見時間的加總。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：在共同可見時窗內排定資料轉送，區分接觸時間、有效酬載與傳播延遲。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver the two-station timeline, volume budget and incomplete-segment list with explicit completeness status.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Two-station overlap: Common visibility is 600 s, not the sum of station windows.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Schedule relay inside a common visibility window while separating contact time, useful payload and propagation delay. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。共同時窗 600 s，不是兩站可見時間的加總。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Common visibility is 600 s, not the sum of station windows.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 共同時窗 600 s，不是兩站可見時間的加總。
steps.checkEn: Common visibility is 600 s, not the sum of station windows.
